StringWithMarkup.String: A ... short synthesis of vitamin K1 and vitamins K2 has been patented by F. Hoffmann-LaRoche. Menadione is first subjected to a Diels-Alder reaction with cyclopentadiene, producing the crystalline endo-Diels-Alder adduct in 93% yield. Subsequently, the proton alpha to the carbonyl group can be abstracted with a strong base (e.g., potassium tertbutoxide) and the resulting enolate alkylated with phytyl bromide (E/Z greater than or equal to 98:2).
